en: The postcard features a sepia-toned or faded panorama of a city with prominent early-20th-century buildings. The foreground has a tree-lined street and several large institutional-looking structures (possibly a school or government facility). There is Cyrillic script both on the image ('Лозята Евксиноградъ') and on the back, with several handwritten and stamped notes in blue, green, and pencil Cyrillic. The stamp 'ЯРОСЛАВ В. ГОЧЕВ ВАРНА' is also visible.
